title: GLM-5.3-Flash CSF on two Sparks (a pair) with decode-context parallelism 2 (research-only)
evidence_scope: The csf deployment of glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2 (local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD at dec48abd33ef) with decode-context parallelism 2, --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 4, mHC prefill row ownership and KDA prefill coalescing off and 14 GiB of KV cache per Spark, on installer image dev-20261010-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl060cd-plugins-status036 (d52737a109e0): one start of these settings, as the installer's DCP1 containers re-created with the profile's rendered differences rather than a sparkring install of the profile, on a pair of an eight-Spark ring held 4,126,165 KV tokens, passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate, wrong or failed response, and against the DCP1 profile's csf deployment on the same pair ran decode 1-6 % fewer engine steps per second and prefill 17 % slower at 64K and 128K (performance/records/images/dev-20261010-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl060cd-plugins-status036-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-dcp2-pair-20261013.md); single-run timing; image and video memory loads not measured; not serving-qualified.
